# Premium Selling Brief – November 5, 2026

## 1. MARKET CONTEXT

SPY and QQQ flat at all-time highs with VIX at 16.81 (+1.21%), signaling low-vol complacency. HV ranks are moderate (SPY 30, QQQ 48), suggesting adequate but not exceptional premium. Environment is **neutral-to-favorable** for premium selling—elevated IVs in single names (TSLA HV rank 17, AMD 52, GOOGL 88) offer pockets of opportunity, but broad market calm limits edge in index strategies.

---

## 2. 🚗 TSLA DAILY

### A. TSLA SHORT PUT RECOMMENDATION

**TSLA @ $385.19 | 2026-11-20 $365P @ $6.67 credit (15 DTE)**

- **Delta:** -0.260 | **IV:** 47.3%
- **Cushion:** $20.19 (5.2%) to strike; breakeven $358.33 (7.0% below current)
- **Volume/OI:** 0 / 2,993 (excellent OI, no volume yet—expect tight fills at open)

**Sizing:**
- Premium-risk cap: $50,000 / (2.0 × $6.67 × 100) = 37.5 contracts
- Single-ticker BP cap: $250,000 / ($365 × 100) = 68.5 contracts
- Contract cap: 10 contracts max
- **BINDING: 10 contracts** (contract cap)

**Total BP deployment:** 10 × $365 × 100 = **$365,000**

**Reminder:** Verify short put strike is ABOVE your current long put floor

---

### B. TSLA COVERED CALL RECOMMENDATION

**TSLA @ $385.19 | 2026-11-20 $400C @ $8.62 credit (15 DTE)**

- **Delta:** 0.369 | **IV:** 44.5%
- **Distance:** $14.81 above current (3.8% upside to strike)
- **Volume/OI:** 0 / 27,361 (exceptional liquidity)

**Sizing:**
- User holds 1,001 shares → max 10 CC contracts
- Delta 0.369 implies ~37% assignment probability; accept early assignment risk for 3.8% upside capture + 2.2% yield ($862 × 10 / $385,190 position value)

**BP deployment:** $0 (covered by shares)

**Note:** Delta >0.30 flags moderate assignment risk—acceptable given strong premium and 3.8% cushion to strike

## 5. WATCH BUT DON'T TRADE

- **NVDA:** Earnings in 12 days (Nov 17)—inside 14-day buffer per rules; wait for post-earnings reset
- **OKLO:** Earnings in 1 day (Nov 6)—inside 7-day buffer; skip entirely
- **TEM:** 75.9% IV with HV rank 47 flags unstable vol regime; high-risk ticker with poor risk/reward
- **AAPL:** HV rank only 27 with 17.6% current IV—insufficient premium for collar construction
- **LLY:** Strike prices too wide ($1,300–$1,400 range) consume excessive BP relative to premium; skip mega-caps with inefficient strikes
- **HOOD:** Recent 11% pullback but HV rank only 21—wait for vol expansion
- **SHOP:** HV rank 33 acceptable but recent earnings catalyst fading; better setups available
- **PLTR:** Delta risk too high (nearest conforming strike has -0.334 delta on 15 DTE); high-risk ticker with adverse technicals (below 50d MA)
- **GILD:** Illiquid options (OI <200 on most strikes); avoid for size

## 7. KEY RISKS / FLAGS

- **VIX expansion risk:** VIX at 16.81 is near 52-week lows—any macro surprise (Fed, geopolitical) could spike vol 20%+ and test all short strikes simultaneously
- **Earnings cluster Nov 12–20:** NVDA (Nov 17) inside buffer but adjacent tickers (AMD, GOOGL, AVGO) may see sympathy vol; monitor cross-correlations
- **Tech sector correlation:** All recommended trades are tech/mega-cap—factor exposure is concentrated; SPY/QQQ hedge may be warranted if deploying >90% BP
